title: https://practice.geeksforgeeks.org/problems/binary-tree-to-dll/1
inputFormat:
Implement binaryTreeToDll(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
The output is read along right pointers; left pointers must link backward correctly.
